cases.raw: what's the difference between a roth ira and a traditional ira and which one makes more sense for me
cases.cleaned: A Roth IRA is funded with after-tax dollars, so qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax-free, while a traditional IRA is funded with pre-tax dollars and taxed on withdrawal. Consider your current income, expected retirement income, and whether you have access to an employer plan.
